hebrewText: בְּֽ֭/צַוָּאר/וֹ יָלִ֣ין עֹ֑ז וּ֝/לְ/פָנָ֗י/ו תָּד֥וּץ דְּאָבָֽה

tokens.bdb: the back of the neck (as that on which burdens are bound)
to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain)
tokens.kjv: abide (all night), continue, dwell, endure, grudge, be left, lie all night, (cause to) lodge (all night, in, -ing, this night), (make to) murmur, remain, tarry (all night, that night).

tokens.bdb: strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise)
tokens.kjv: boldness, loud, might, power, strength, strong.

tokens.bdb: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
